name: width-regime-mark
rationale: The two FrictionTransfer mounts on /rl-sim2real/sim2real-transfer/ rendered digit-normalised-identical chart descriptions, failing VAL-EDU-036(d): every number differed (0.35 vs 0.65 half-width, 74% vs 57% plateau) but masked to the same text. The successor adds one computed width-regime mark, exactly the latency-comparison marked-status pattern: range >= 0.5 renders 'The randomization band is marked wide at the selected half-width.', otherwise 'marked ordinary'. No number, formula, or mount prop changes; the ten proofs that pinned the predecessor bytes keep reading them via this named transition.
